experiment: Six three-span continuous lapped Z-purlin assemblies (two purlin lines, 20 ft spans, through-fastened roof panel) were loaded to failure with simulated gravity load in a vacuum chamber, and the measured failure loads and modes were compared with AISI shear-plus-bending predictions.
title: Vacuum Chamber Tests of Three-Span Continuous Lapped Z-Purlin Systems: Shear Plus Bending Limit State

variables.definition: Test designation of the purlin assembly as printed in the report (e.g. FV20-1).
variables.name: Test identification
variables.note: FV20-3 and FV20-3A are the same test.

variables.definition: Z-purlin designation of each bay, 8.5 in. deep with the last two digits giving nominal thickness in thousandths of an inch.
variables.name: Purlin size designation
variables.note: Given per bay; end bays and center bay may differ.

variables.definition: Cross-section shape of the test member, recorded as Z for all tests.
variables.name: Section type

variables.definition: Nominal out-to-out depth of the Z-purlin section (8.5 in. for all tests).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column depth_in; implied by the 8.5Z designations in Table 2.1
variables.name: Purlin depth

variables.definition: Measured thickness of the tensile coupon machined from the web of the failed purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2, p.8; repeated in Table S1
variables.name: Coupon (purlin) thickness
variables.note: Report does not state which purlin of the assembly the coupon came from.

variables.definition: Center-to-center span length of each of the three continuous bays (20.0 ft for all tests).
variables.evidence: Table 2.1, p.8; Table S1 column span_ft
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Length of the lapped purlin extending into each bay from the interior supports.
variables.name: Lap length into bay

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the test setup (three for every test).
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the vacuum-chamber test assembly (two for every test).
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Measured yield stress of the purlin steel from a standard tensile coupon taken from undamaged web material of the failed purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2, p.8; repeated in Table S1
variables.name: Yield stress

variables.definition: Measured ultimate tensile strength of the purlin steel from the tensile coupon test.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2, p.8; repeated in Table S1
variables.name: Tensile strength

variables.definition: Measured elongation of the tensile coupon at fracture.
variables.name: Coupon elongation
variables.note: Gage length not stated in the table.

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load, gravity simulated by evacuating air from the vacuum chamber.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column load_direction and header note on load direction
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Roof panel/deck type attached to the purlins as printed on the appendix test summary (through-fastened screw-down panel; doubled for FV20-3).
variables.name: Roof panel type

variables.definition: Lateral bracing condition of the purlin lines as printed on the appendix test summary (at supports only).
variables.name: Bracing condition

variables.definition: Direction the purlin top flanges face as printed on each test's summary sheet (both out, or opposed/in).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column purlin_orientation; per-test sheets pp.22, 31, 42, 55, 68, 81
variables.name: Purlin orientation
variables.note: Conflicts with Chapter 2 text which says all tests had opposed top flanges (MBMA_9704-Q04).

variables.definition: Center-to-center spacing of the two purlin lines, 4'-11" for FV20-1 and FV20-2 and 5'-0" for the remaining tests, with a 1'-0" deck overhang.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on purlin spacing
variables.name: Purlin spacing and deck overhang
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Tributary width of 3.75 ft used by the report to convert chamber pressure (psf) to a line load on one purlin.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note: Applied Loading = 3.75 x pressure (psf)
variables.name: Tributary width factor
variables.note: Report does not explain the 3.75 ft value and it does not follow from the purlin spacing (MBMA_9704-Q01).

variables.definition: Purlin self-weight added to the applied line load, 8 plf for all tests except FV20-3 where 12 plf was used for the doubled panel.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header notes on failure load composition and FV20-3 self-weight
variables.name: Purlin self-weight included
variables.note: Stated in notes, not a column.

variables.definition: Support detail: anti-roll clips at all supports (both lines) with web stiffeners on the south line for FV20-1 and FV20-2, and anti-roll clips with no web stiffeners for the other tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on anti-roll clips and web stiffeners
variables.name: Support restraint detail
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Chamber differential pressure at failure measured with U-tube manometers, as printed on the appendix test summary.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column pressure_at_failure_psf; appendix sheets
variables.name: Chamber pressure at failure
variables.note: Approximate values printed for FV20-4 and FV25-2 (MBMA_9704-Q02).

variables.definition: Total uniform line load on one purlin at failure, computed as 3.75 ft times the failure pressure plus purlin self-weight, as printed in Table 3.2.
variables.evidence: Table 3.2, p.16; Table S1 column failure_load_as_printed
variables.name: Actual failure load
variables.note: Printed values carried as given despite the FV20-4 pressure-factor inconsistency.

variables.definition: Observed failure mode described in the report for each test (e.g. purlin rolling and web crippling at support, flexural failure after web lateral buckling).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column failure_mode; appendix test summaries
variables.name: Observed failure mode

variables.definition: Failure load predicted by the AISI shear-plus-bending interaction limit state.
variables.evidence: Table 3.2, p.16; Table S1 column predicted_failure_load_plf
variables.name: Predicted failure load
variables.note: One value per test; report does not say which purlin line governs (MBMA_9704-Q03).

variables.definition: Actual failure load expressed as a percentage of the shear-plus-bending predicted failure load.
variables.evidence: Table 3.2, p.16; Table S1 column percent_of_predicted_load
variables.name: Test-to-predicted load ratio

variables.definition: Yes/No entry stating whether the predicted shear-plus-bending limit state was the mode actually observed, with footnote marker.
variables.evidence: Table 3.2, p.16 (footnotes 1 and 2); Table S1 column expected_failure_mode_flag
variables.name: Expected failure mode occurred
variables.note: Footnote 1 = purlin failed at exterior support; 2 = bottom flanges buckled over support.

variables.definition: Required moment in the positive moment region at the recorded failure load, from a stiffness analysis of the lapped continuous system.
variables.name: Required moment, positive region
variables.note: Analysis value, not a measured failure moment.

variables.definition: Nominal flexural strength about the centroidal x-axis in the positive moment region computed per AISI.
variables.name: Nominal moment, positive region

variables.definition: Ratio Mu/Mnxo in the positive moment region at the failure load (positive-moment unity check).
variables.name: Unity check, positive region

variables.definition: Required moment just outside the lap in the negative moment region at the recorded failure load, from stiffness analysis.
variables.name: Required moment, negative region
variables.note: Analysis value, not a measured failure moment.

variables.definition: Nominal flexural strength in the negative moment region just outside the lap computed per AISI.
variables.name: Nominal moment, negative region

variables.definition: Ratio of required to nominal moment in the negative moment region at the failure load.
variables.name: Moment ratio, negative region

variables.definition: Required shear strength just outside the lap at the recorded failure load, from stiffness analysis.
variables.name: Required shear

variables.definition: Nominal shear strength of the purlin web when shear alone exists, computed per AISI.
variables.name: Nominal shear strength

variables.definition: Ratio of required to nominal shear strength just outside the lap at the failure load.
variables.name: Shear ratio

variables.definition: Shear-plus-bending interaction unity check in the negative moment region, (Mu/Mnxo)^2 + (Vu/Vn)^2 per AISI Eq. C3.3.2-1.
variables.name: Unity check, negative region
